enitoys.name: Robond
enitoys.info: Robond seek out Tamers with whom they can form a strong bond. If a Robond follows you, it is seen as a good omen. However, if you approach a Robond and it flees from you, it is seen as a bad omen that calls for self-improvement.

catalogEntries.entry: Robond seek out Tamers with whom they can form a strong bond. If a Robond follows you, it is seen as a good omen. However, if you approach a Robond and it flees from you, it is seen as a bad omen that calls for self-improvement.
A Robond remembers every act of kindness shown to it. Once it decides that someone is worthy of its friendship, its wind-up key seems to turn more smoothly whenever that person is nearby.

nameOrigins.description: an automatic machine that can sense its environment, make decisions, and take physical action
a deep, enduring psychological connection between two people that carries real emotional weight and mutual care

enitoys.name: Amigearoot
enitoys.info: Amigearoot carefully tend to plants and will often repair damaged roots with their mechanical hands. They become especially protective of Tamers who show patience and kindness toward living things.

catalogEntries.entry: Amigearoot carefully tend to plants and will often repair damaged roots with their mechanical hands. They become especially protective of Tamers who show patience and kindness toward living things.
It can detect unhealthy plants by gently touching their roots. Farmers sometimes invite wild Amigearoot into their fields, as crops tended by one are said to recover remarkably quickly.

nameOrigins.description: Spanish for friend
a toothed wheel in a machine that transmits power and changes speed or direction, or to the equipment and clothing used for a specific activity
The part of a plant that grows below the ground, holds it in place, and takes in water and food

enitoys.name: Mechalsamity
enitoys.info: Plants grow across Mechalsamity's body as it patrols the forests under its protection. It cares tenderly for endangered life but shows no mercy to those it believes threaten the ecosystem. It is often regarded as a dangerous guardian.

catalogEntries.entry: Plants grow across Mechalsamity's body as it patrols the forests under its protection. It cares tenderly for endangered life but shows no mercy to those it believes threaten the ecosystem. It is often regarded as a dangerous guardian.
The plants growing across its mechanical body are home to many tiny creatures. A forest inhabited by Mechalsamity can become strangely quiet whenever it senses an intruder with harmful intentions.

nameOrigins.description: giant, piloted or sentient robotic and mechanical vehicles
a dark, sweet, and tangy condiment made from freshly crushed grape juice
a peaceful and friendly relationship between people, groups, or countries

enitoys.name: Amigearoast
enitoys.info: Amigearoast generate intense heat inside their bodies and release it through vents when excited. They are energetic, competitive, and quick to defend any Tamer they consider a close friend.

catalogEntries.entry: Amigearoast generate intense heat inside their bodies and release it through vents when excited. They are energetic, competitive, and quick to defend any Tamer they consider a close friend.
The hotter its internal furnace becomes, the more restless it grows. An excited Amigearoast may accidentally leave tiny scorch marks wherever it sits.

nameOrigins.description: Spanish for friend
a toothed wheel in a machine that transmits power and changes speed or direction, or to the equipment and clothing used for a specific activity
To cook food (like meat or vegetables) uncovered in an oven or over an open fire using dry, indirect heat

enitoys.name: Mecharmity
enitoys.info: Mecharmity draws dangerous fires into its body before they can spread. The heat it stores can be unleashed as burning flames or caustic smoke against anything it judges harmful to the ecosystem.

catalogEntries.entry: Mecharmity draws dangerous fires into its body before they can spread. The heat it stores can be unleashed as burning flames or caustic smoke against anything it judges harmful to the ecosystem.
Smoke constantly filters through mechanisms hidden beneath its armor. After extinguishing a wildfire, it may remain motionless for days while slowly releasing the heat it absorbed.

nameOrigins.description: giant, piloted or sentient robotic and mechanical vehicles
to burn or blacken the surface of something slightly
a peaceful and friendly relationship between people, groups, or countries

enitoys.name: Amigearinse
enitoys.info: Amigearinse store clean water inside special tanks throughout their bodies. They use it to wash away dirt, cool overheated machinery, and care for Tamers who have earned their trust.

catalogEntries.entry: Amigearinse store clean water inside special tanks throughout their bodies. They use it to wash away dirt, cool overheated machinery, and care for Tamers who have earned their trust.
It keeps its internal water supply remarkably pure. Lost travelers have learned that an Amigearinse willing to offer them water has already decided that they can be trusted.

nameOrigins.description: Spanish for friend
a toothed wheel in a machine that transmits power and changes speed or direction, or to the equipment and clothing used for a specific activity
to wash something with clean water to remove soap, dirt, or loose particles

enitoys.name: Mechainmity
enitoys.info: Mechainmity rushes toward fires and drenches them with water stored throughout its body. It uses any water left over to cultivate lush gardens throughout its territory and ferociously defends them from anything it perceives as a threat.

catalogEntries.entry: Mechainmity rushes toward fires and drenches them with water stored throughout its body. It uses any water left over to cultivate lush gardens throughout its territory and ferociously defends them from anything it perceives as a threat.
Wherever a Mechainmity settles, unusually lush vegetation soon appears. It fiercely guards these patches of greenery and remembers anyone who has damaged them before.

nameOrigins.description: giant, piloted or sentient robotic and mechanical vehicles
liquid water that condenses from water vapor in the atmosphere and falls to Earth in drops
a peaceful and friendly relationship between people, groups, or countries

enitoys.name: Mework
enitoys.info: Mework are adorable little stuffed kitten plush toys brought to life. However, because they are inhabited by the spirits of cats they are able to use claws and teeth not sewn into the original plush toy. If you feed a Mework, they will loyally follow you until the ends of the Earth.

catalogEntries.entry: Mework are adorable little stuffed kitten plush toys brought to life. However, because they are inhabited by the spirits of cats they are able to use claws and teeth not sewn into the original plush toy. If you feed a Mework, they will loyally follow you until the ends of the Earth.
It instinctively kneads soft surfaces with its paws despite having no biological reason to do so. Old blankets used by Mework often become covered in tiny punctures from invisible claws.

nameOrigins.description: the soft, high-pitched crying sound made by a cat or kitten
a piece of cloth made by sewing together many smaller pieces of different colors and patterns, or a mixture of diverse parts

enitoys.name: Pluschro
enitoys.info: Pluschro are often seen disappearing into the afterlife for short periods of time. It is believed they are visiting the deceased to show them love. On rare occasions, Pluschro have been seen to disappear holding a ball of yarn only to reappear a couple of hours later wearing freshly knitted clothes from the same yarn.

catalogEntries.entry: Pluschro are often seen disappearing into the afterlife for short periods of time. It is believed they are visiting the deceased to show them love. On rare occasions, Pluschro have been seen to disappear holding a ball of yarn only to reappear a couple of hours later wearing freshly knitted clothes from the same yarn.
No one knows exactly where a Pluschro goes when it vanishes. Objects belonging to deceased people have occasionally disappeared with one and returned neatly repaired.

nameOrigins.description: a thick, soft fabric similar to velvet, a soft stuffed toy, or something very luxurious and expensive
The last name of Erwin Schrödinger a famous theoretical physicist who developed fundamental results in quantum theory most known for "Schrödinger's cat"

enitoys.name: Bakatail
enitoys.info: Bakatail are often seen as tricksters that play many tricks upon unsuspecting children who have wandered far from home at night. As a result, it is a common phrase to say "Blinded by a Bakatail's cloth", which means that a person has fallen for a terrible or dumb trick that should have been obvious.

catalogEntries.entry: Bakatail are often seen as tricksters that play many tricks upon unsuspecting children who have wandered far from home at night. As a result, it is a common phrase to say "Blinded by a Bakatail's cloth", which means that a person has fallen for a terrible or dumb trick that should have been obvious.
It delights in leading nighttime travelers in circles while remaining just outside their sight. A Bakatail that genuinely likes someone will instead use its tricks to guide them safely home.

nameOrigins.description: a cat trickster yokai
a corruption of the word cat for spelling
the flexible rear appendage on an animal's body

enitoys.name: Chicadet
enitoys.info: Chicadet are small wind-up bird toys brought to life by the spirits of young songbirds. The key on their backs turns rapidly while they fly, producing a soft ticking sound. Although their songs are simple, they practice them constantly until every note is perfect.

catalogEntries.entry: Chicadet are small wind-up bird toys brought to life by the spirits of young songbirds. The key on their backs turns rapidly while they fly, producing a soft ticking sound. Although their songs are simple, they practice them constantly until every note is perfect.
Young Chicadet practice songs by repeating the same handful of notes for hours. Their ticking wind-up keys naturally fall into rhythm with the melodies they sing.

nameOrigins.description: a baby bird, especially a newly hatched chicken
a young person who is training to become an officer in the military, police force, or other uniformed services

enitoys.name: Chimajor
enitoys.info: Chimajor develop music-box components within their chests as they modify. The sound of their wings is accompanied by clear chimes that change pitch depending on how fast they fly. Groups of Chimajor often practice together until their songs are perfectly synchronized.

catalogEntries.entry: Chimajor develop music-box components within their chests as they modify. The sound of their wings is accompanied by clear chimes that change pitch depending on how fast they fly. Groups of Chimajor often practice together until their songs are perfectly synchronized.
Several Chimajor flying together can arrange their chimes into complete harmonies. Musicians sometimes follow migrating flocks simply to hear melodies that have never been performed before.

nameOrigins.description: a clear, ringing, musical tone or a series of harmonious notes produced by striking a bell, metal tube, or similar object
greater in size, rank, importance, or seriousness

enitoys.name: Aviaestro
enitoys.info: Aviaestro possess complex music-box mechanisms throughout their bodies. By controlling the movement of their wings, feathers, and internal gears, they can perform entire melodies without opening their beaks. Other Enitoy often gather in silence to listen when an Aviaestro begins to play.

catalogEntries.entry: Aviaestro possess complex music-box mechanisms throughout their bodies. By controlling the movement of their wings, feathers, and internal gears, they can perform entire melodies without opening their beaks. Other Enitoy often gather in silence to listen when an Aviaestro begins to play.
The mechanisms inside its body are so precise that even a damaged gear can alter the mood of its music. Skilled Tamers claim they can tell how an Aviaestro feels simply by listening.

nameOrigins.description: relating to, characteristic of, or connected with birds
a person who has great skill and mastery in an art, most commonly a composer, teacher, or conductor of music

enitoys.name: Hootton
enitoys.info: Hootton are soft owl plush toys that remain almost completely silent while flying. They often perch in dark places and quietly observe everything around them. When they trust someone, they will wrap their wings around them like a warm blanket.

catalogEntries.entry: Hootton are soft owl plush toys that remain almost completely silent while flying. They often perch in dark places and quietly observe everything around them. When they trust someone, they will wrap their wings around them like a warm blanket.
Its soft feathers absorb much of the sound around it, making its resting place unnaturally quiet. People troubled by sleeplessness sometimes keep a trusted Hootton beside their bed.

nameOrigins.description: the low, rhythmic call made by an owl
a soft, white, fluffy fiber that grows around the seeds of warm-climate plants and is used to make thread, yarn, and fabric

enitoys.name: Telekniturnal
enitoys.info: Teleknitural use their psychic power to move their large plush bodies through the air without flapping their wings. They can manipulate loose threads and stuffing as though they were extra limbs. It is said they can sense a person's intentions before that person acts.

catalogEntries.entry: Teleknitural use their psychic power to move their large plush bodies through the air without flapping their wings. They can manipulate loose threads and stuffing as though they were extra limbs. It is said they can sense a person's intentions before that person acts.
Loose fibers rise from the ground whenever it concentrates. It has been observed silently repairing damaged plush toys without ever physically touching them.

nameOrigins.description: a purported psychic ability to move or change physical objects using only the power of the mind, without any physical contact
to make a fabric or garment by interlacing yarn with needles
being active, happening, or relating to the night rather than during the day

enitoys.name: Riduni
enitoys.info: Riduni travel by balancing atop balls made from dung, mud, and small stones. They often wobble, crash, or roll in the wrong direction, but they quickly repair their balls and try again. A Riduni that can ride without falling is considered ready to modify.

catalogEntries.entry: Riduni travel by balancing atop balls made from dung, mud, and small stones. They often wobble, crash, or roll in the wrong direction, but they quickly repair their balls and try again. A Riduni that can ride without falling is considered ready to modify.
It becomes unusually determined after falling from its ball. Some Riduni deliberately attempt increasingly ridiculous obstacles, seemingly treating every crash as valuable practice.

nameOrigins.description: to travel by sitting on an animal or inside a vehicle
solid waste or fecal droppings passed by animals
a one-wheeled vehicle that a person rides by sitting on a seat and pedaling

enitoys.name: Terrhidung
enitoys.info: Terrhidung compress dung and mud into two tough, wheel-shaped balls that allow them to race across almost any terrain. They steer by turning their handlebar-shaped horns and shifting their weight between the two wheels. Terrhidung sometimes allow trusted Tamers to ride on their backs.

catalogEntries.entry: Terrhidung compress dung and mud into two tough, wheel-shaped balls that allow them to race across almost any terrain. They steer by turning their handlebar-shaped horns and shifting their weight between the two wheels. Terrhidung sometimes allow trusted Tamers to ride on their backs.
The compact wheels beneath it can carry enormous weight without losing their shape. Old desert roads have occasionally been discovered by following the parallel tracks left by traveling Terrhidung.

nameOrigins.description: a specific area of land and the physical features or shape of its surface
herbivorous insects named for the horn-like projections on and around the males' heads
solid waste or fecal droppings passed by animals

enitoys.name: Duscara
enitoys.info: Despite being bugs that might be expected to terrify small children, Duscara are often seen as calming. The faint glow from the ends of their abdomens has even been observed soothing restless children to sleep when they are afraid of the dark.

catalogEntries.entry: Despite being bugs that might be expected to terrify small children, Duscara are often seen as calming. The faint glow from the ends of their abdomens has even been observed soothing restless children to sleep when they are afraid of the dark.
Its faint glow changes slightly depending on the emotions of nearby creatures. A frightened Duscara shines brightest when it senses someone else who is equally afraid.

nameOrigins.description: the time of day immediately following sunset when the sky begins to grow dark
A beetle of the species Scarabaeus sacer, sacred to the ancient Egyptians

enitoys.name: Soothorlax
enitoys.info: Duscara that modify into Soothorlax can emit a glow capable of calming even the darkest nightmares in full-grown adults. Soothorlax tend to glow brighter when fed delicious honey and warm milk before bed, while they glow dimmer when fed blander foods.

catalogEntries.entry: Duscara that modify into Soothorlax can emit a glow capable of calming even the darkest nightmares in full-grown adults. Soothorlax tend to glow brighter when fed delicious honey and warm milk before bed, while they glow dimmer when fed blander foods.
People sleeping near one frequently report unusually peaceful dreams. Its warm glow dims just before dawn, when it becomes sluggish and searches for somewhere comfortable to rest.

nameOrigins.description: (transitive) To restore to ease, comfort, or tranquility; relieve; calm; quiet; refresh
(anatomy) The region of the mammalian body between the neck and abdomen as well as the cavity containing the heart and lungs
to become calm

enitoys.name: Domustel
enitoys.info: Domustel love to curl up among ordinary stuffed toys, making them difficult to notice until they begin to move. They quickly grow attached to anyone who plays with them and often hide in bags, sleeves, or blankets to follow their favorite companion.

catalogEntries.entry: Domustel love to curl up among ordinary stuffed toys, making them difficult to notice until they begin to move. They quickly grow attached to anyone who plays with them and often hide in bags, sleeves, or blankets to follow their favorite companion.
It is remarkably good at pretending to be an ordinary stuffed toy. Some families have unknowingly owned a Domustel for days before realizing that the toy keeps changing where it sits.

nameOrigins.description: Of or relating to the home
A taxonomic family within the order Carnivora – otters, badgers, honey badgers, weasels, etc

enitoys.name: Comustelux
enitoys.info: A Comustelux's markings glow brighter when it senses that its companion is afraid or lonely. It wraps its long plush body around those it trusts, using its soft light and gentle presence to help them feel safe.

catalogEntries.entry: A Comustelux's markings glow brighter when it senses that its companion is afraid or lonely. It wraps its long plush body around those it trusts, using its soft light and gentle presence to help them feel safe.
Its glowing markings pulse slowly while comforting someone it trusts. When several gather together, their synchronized light can illuminate an entire room without disturbing sleeping children.

nameOrigins.description: A friend, acquaintance or partner; someone with whom one spends time or accompanies
A taxonomic family within the order Carnivora – otters, badgers, honey badgers, weasels, etc
In the International System of Units, the derived unit of illuminance or illumination; one lumen per square metre. Symbol: lx

enitoys.name: Ogrio
enitoys.info: Ogrio are small ogre-like Enitoy known for their sharp temper and quick movements. When angered, static energy begins to crackle around their horns and hair. Despite their attitude, they become fiercely protective of Tamers who earn their respect.

catalogEntries.entry: Ogrio are small ogre-like Enitoy known for their sharp temper and quick movements. When angered, static energy begins to crackle around their horns and hair. Despite their attitude, they become fiercely protective of Tamers who earn their respect.
Static pops from its horns whenever it becomes irritated. Experienced Tamers learn to judge an Ogrio's mood by how loudly its hair crackles before approaching it.

nameOrigins.description: (mythology, folklore) A large, grotesque, brutish humanoid monster, typically marked by great strength and a propensity to kill or devour humans
A Japanese girl name

enitoys.name: Rionight
enitoys.info: After modifying, Rionight become faster and more confident, using bursts of static energy to overwhelm their opponents. They take great pride in their strength and will challenge anything they believe has insulted them or their Tamer.

catalogEntries.entry: After modifying, Rionight become faster and more confident, using bursts of static energy to overwhelm their opponents. They take great pride in their strength and will challenge anything they believe has insulted them or their Tamer.
It considers retreat deeply embarrassing and may continue fighting long after victory is impossible. However, it will abandon any battle instantly if its Tamer is in danger.

nameOrigins.description: A Japanese girl name
a large, fierce type of demon, ogre, or yōkai (supernatural spirit) from Japanese folklore
(countable, uncountable) Power, strength, force, or influence held by a person or group

enitoys.name: Ogryo
enitoys.info: Ogryo are stocky ogre-like Enitoy that often try to prove their strength through rough play and friendly competition. Their anger causes static energy to build inside their bodies, making their hair and horns spark when they become excited.

catalogEntries.entry: Ogryo are stocky ogre-like Enitoy that often try to prove their strength through rough play and friendly competition. Their anger causes static energy to build inside their bodies, making their hair and horns spark when they become excited.
It often challenges other Enitoy to contests of strength that are much friendlier than they initially appear. Winning earns its respect, but losing gracefully seems to impress it just as much.

nameOrigins.description: (mythology, folklore) A large, grotesque, brutish humanoid monster, typically marked by great strength and a propensity to kill or devour humans
A Japanese boy name

enitoys.name: Ryonight
enitoys.info: Ryonight are powerful oni Enitoy that rely on toughness and endurance to outlast their opponents. The static energy stored within their bodies erupts when they are struck, and they are known to defend their Tamers with relentless determination.

catalogEntries.entry: Ryonight are powerful oni Enitoy that rely on toughness and endurance to outlast their opponents. The static energy stored within their bodies erupts when they are struck, and they are known to defend their Tamers with relentless determination.
Its body can withstand enormous punishment before it shows signs of exhaustion. Each impact causes more static to accumulate, making prolonged battles increasingly dangerous for its opponent.

nameOrigins.description: A Japanese boy name
a large, fierce type of demon, ogre, or yōkai (supernatural spirit) from Japanese folklore
(countable, uncountable) Power, strength, force, or influence held by a person or group

enitoys.name: Kappabe
enitoys.info: Kappabe get their name from a legend about ghosts from a faraway land that were referred to as kappas. However, not long after, it was discovered that they were actually Kappabe, and the name has since stuck across all regions.

catalogEntries.entry: Kappabe get their name from a legend about ghosts from a faraway land that were referred to as kappas. However, not long after, it was discovered that they were actually Kappabe, and the name has since stuck across all regions.

It mimics human children with surprising accuracy but frequently misunderstands small details of their behavior. This has resulted in countless local stories about strangely behaved children near rivers.

nameOrigins.description: a familiar type of water monster
(now literary or poetic) A baby or infant; a very young human or animal

enitoys.name: Lilad
enitoys.info: Male Kappabe seem to be able to modify only into this more masculine species. Lilad tend to resemble small human boys, and some theorize they use this resemblance to drown similarly sized human children and replace them.

catalogEntries.entry: Male Kappabe seem to be able to modify only into this more masculine species. Lilad tend to resemble small human boys, and some theorize they use this resemblance to drown similarly sized human children and replace them.
It watches human settlements from waterways and copies the behavior of young boys it observes. Whether it does this out of curiosity or for more sinister reasons remains heavily debated.

nameOrigins.description: an informal short form of the word "little"
a boy, young man, or male friend

enitoys.name: Kawateronin
enitoys.info: Often referred to as ronin of the water, these strange Enitoy devote themselves to a single master. When they no longer serve that master, their former Tamers swear they can still feel a Kawateronin's eyes watching them from the shadows at night, leaving them unable to sleep peacefully.

catalogEntries.entry: Often referred to as ronin of the water, these strange Enitoy devote themselves to a single master. When they no longer serve that master, their former Tamers swear they can still feel a Kawateronin's eyes watching them from the shadows at night, leaving them unable to sleep peacefully.

Once it accepts someone as its master, its loyalty can persist even after years of separation. Travelers occasionally report seeing a silent Kawateronin watching over former Tamers from distant shorelines.

nameOrigins.description: another name for kappas
a clear, colorless, odorless, and tasteless liquid compound
"wave man" in Japanese, symbolizing a drifter or a wanderer tossed about like an ocean wave

enitoys.name: Lilass
enitoys.info: Female Kappabe seem to be able to modify only into this more feminine species. Lilass tend to resemble small human girls, and some theorize they use this resemblance to hypnotize similarly sized human children and replace them.

catalogEntries.entry: Female Kappabe seem to be able to modify only into this more feminine species. Lilass tend to resemble small human girls, and some theorize they use this resemblance to hypnotize similarly sized human children and replace them.
It imitates the voices and mannerisms of children with unsettling precision. Parents living near its habitat often warn children never to follow a familiar voice coming from the water.

nameOrigins.description: an informal short form of the word "little"
A girl; also (by extension), a young woman

enitoys.name: Yokawater
enitoys.info: Often referred to as witches of the water, these strange Enitoy devote themselves to learning to dance with ocean waves and falling rain. Their dances can cause the very heavens to send rain down. Seeing a Yokawater during a harsh drought is often considered a blessing, though not one that comes without a price.

Their dances can cause the very heavens to send rain down. Seeing a Yokawater during a harsh drought is often considered a blessing, though not one that comes without a price.
Its dances become more elaborate as humidity rises. Large gatherings have been blamed for sudden rainstorms appearing over areas where the sky had been completely clear moments earlier.

nameOrigins.description: (folklore, Japanese mythology) Any of various supernatural monsters, sometimes shapeshifters, in Japanese folklore
another name for kappas
a clear, colorless, odorless, and tasteless liquid compound

enitoys.name: Kalamarky
enitoys.info: Kalamarky often use paints created from crushed berries to make fun doodles. However, they do not seem to care where they place their artwork. Kalamarky doodles can often be found on trees, rocks, and other surfaces near their territory. Be warned: you will never see just one Kalamarky, as they travel in schools.

Kalamarky doodles can often be found on trees, rocks, and other surfaces near their territory. Be warned: you will never see just one Kalamarky, as they travel in schools.

It can recognize the individual artwork of other Kalamarky. Rival schools sometimes cover each other's drawings with increasingly elaborate paintings in what appears to be an ongoing artistic competition.

nameOrigins.description: (cooking) Squid as food, especially cooked in the form of calamari rings
a visible sign, symbol, or blemish on a surface

enitoys.name: Octopaint
enitoys.info: When Kalamarky modify into Octopaint, their simple doodles develop into full-fledged works of art and masterpieces. There was once an Octopaint so talented at painting that it created a fake tunnel on a wall that actually fooled people. The scientific name for an Octopaint is Octopaint vulgarinum.

There was once an Octopaint so talented at painting that it created a fake tunnel on a wall that actually fooled people. The scientific name for an Octopaint is Octopaint vulgarinum.
It mixes pigments with astonishing precision and seems offended by poorly matched colors. Paintings created by exceptionally old individuals have been preserved as valuable works of art.

nameOrigins.description: A taxonomic genus within the family Octopodidae – typical octopuses
A substance that is applied as a liquid or paste, and dries into a solid coating that protects or adds colour to an object or surface to which it has been applied

enitoys.name: Lapaws
enitoys.info: Lapaws are quiet rabbit Enitoy that rarely make any sound beyond the soft tapping of their paws. They will often sit near musicians and listen intently, though they seem unable to understand why the sounds affect them so deeply. When a Lapaws finally attempts to sing, it may begin to modify.

It often taps one foot unconsciously when music is playing nearby. The rhythm becomes more complicated as it grows closer to discovering the style of music it loves.

nameOrigins.description: French for rabbit
the soft foot of an animal that has claws or nails

enitoys.name: Melapinna
enitoys.info: Melapinna have discovered a deep love of music and spend hours practicing songs they have heard. Their large ears can detect even the smallest change in pitch, allowing them to copy nearly any melody. As their musical tastes develop, they eventually modify to reflect the genre they love most.

French for rabbit
(anatomy, zoology) The visible part of the ear in most therians that resides outside of the head, the auricle; outer ear excluding the ear canal

enitoys.name: Tontaudisco
enitoys.info: Tontaudisco perform fast techno music using synthesized sounds and static energy generated throughout their bodies. Their ears flash in time with the beat, while their rapid footwork can turn any open space into a dance floor. Groups of Tontaudisco are known to hold raves that continue until sunrise.

Their ears flash in time with the beat, while their rapid footwork can turn any open space into a dance floor. Groups of Tontaudisco are known to hold raves that continue until sunrise.
Its body builds static as it dances, causing its performances to become brighter and louder over time. Outdoor gatherings of Tontaudisco are sometimes mistaken for distant thunderstorms.

nameOrigins.description: a small, wild North American rabbit with brownish-gray fur and a short, fluffy tail that is white on the underside
Focused on audible sound, as opposed to sight
an upbeat style of dance music and cultural movement

enitoys.name: Tontaudoll
enitoys.info: Tontaudoll develop polished voices, brilliant costumes, and expressions so perfect that they can appear almost like living dolls. They devote themselves to entertaining their audiences and will continue performing even when exhausted. The light they produce grows brighter when they hear their fans cheering.

They devote themselves to entertaining their audiences and will continue performing even when exhausted. The light they produce grows brighter when they hear their fans cheering.

It carefully practices every movement until even its smallest gestures appear intentional. Some fans become convinced that their favorite Tontaudoll recognizes them individually among enormous crowds.

Focused on audible sound, as opposed to sight
A small figure resembling a human being that is used as a toy

enitoys.name: Tontaudistor
enitoys.info: Tontaudistor create grunge music through harsh vocals, heavy rhythms, and deliberately distorted sound. Their performances are loud, messy, and often leave the surrounding area covered in scratches and scorch marks. Despite their heavy bodies, Purraoh move with surprising grace and are known to silently observe opponents before choosing the perfect moment to strike.

enitoys.name: Meterupa
enitoys.info: Meterupa are living dolls made from thin sheets of paper. They are often seen hanging from trees and eaves, gently swaying with the wind. Their bodies are extremely sensitive to changes in the atmosphere, and will transform to match the weather around them.

enitoys.name: Gummini
enitoys.info: Despite its tiny size, Gummini is surprisingly resilient. Its soft, gummy body can stretch, compress, and bend around obstacles without suffering much harm. It spends most of its time wriggling through loose soil and narrow cracks in search of food, sometimes squeezing through openings that appear far too small for it. When startled, Gummini curls itself into a tight coil and relies on its flexible body to absorb the impact.

enitoys.name: Tarterraga
enitoys.info: Exposure to an Ancient Stone transforms Gummini’s soft body into the massive, hardened form of Tarterraga. Ancient energy courses through the layers of stone covering its serpentine body, giving it tremendous weight and durability. It slowly burrows through the earth by forcing aside rock and compacted soil, leaving wide trails of rubble in its wake. Some old ruins contain carvings resembling Tarterraga, suggesting that creatures like it may have existed long before the modern era.

enitoys.name: Bytro
enitoys.info: Bytro are born when spirits made almost entirely of electricity possess discarded handheld game systems near the desert factory where the devices are produced. Their screens flicker with expressions of their own, and they often gather around charging stations and piles of unused electronics.

catalogEntries.entry: Bytro are born when spirits made almost entirely of electricity possess discarded handheld game systems near the desert factory where the devices are produced. Their screens flicker with expressions of their own, and they often gather around charging stations and piles of unused electronics.

The cartridge slot on a Bytro is not merely decorative. When one accepts a compatible game cartridge, its electrical spirit alters the console’s functions to match the data inside. A Bytro without a cartridge remains in its ordinary form and shows no signs of modifying.

enitoys.name: Ruggrade
enitoys.info: Ruggrade can shape its energy into tools suited to almost any environment. It has an unusual habit of building elaborate shelters that it immediately abandons once it discovers a more interesting location.

enitoys.name: Nougrade
enitoys.info: Nougrade uses its energy to prepare meals with remarkable precision. It can manage several cooking tasks simultaneously and becomes noticeably upset when someone interrupts a recipe before completion.

enitoys.name: Smuggrade

enitoys.name: Disgrade

catalogEntries.entry: Lograde possesses an extraordinary talent for recognizing patterns and predicting outcomes. Its surrounding energy rearranges itself into intricate geometric shapes whenever it encounters a particularly difficult problem.

enitoys.name: Foadow
enitoys.info: Foadow are most commonly spotted wandering the desert at dusk. Despite their small size, they possess an unsettling presence, and travelers claim that their shadows sometimes continue moving even after they have stopped.

catalogEntries.entry: Foadow are most commonly spotted wandering the desert at dusk. Despite their small size, they possess an unsettling presence, and travelers claim that their shadows sometimes continue moving even after they have stopped.

Ancient legends claim that Foadow are born wherever great misfortune is destined to occur. Although there is little evidence supporting this belief, their eerie whinnies have been known to send entire herds of wild Enitoy fleeing in terror.

enitoys.name: Galloom
enitoys.info: Galloom are known to gallop across the desert at night, leaving trails of unnatural darkness in their wake. Travelers who hear their haunting whinnies often report an overwhelming sense of dread, even when no Galloom can be seen nearby.

catalogEntries.entry: Galloom are known to gallop across the desert at night, leaving trails of unnatural darkness in their wake. Travelers who hear their haunting whinnies often report an overwhelming sense of dread, even when no Galloom can be seen nearby.

enitoys.name: Equihinox

enitoys.name: Gelus
enitoys.info: Gelus may be small, but their heavy paws can leave deep prints in frozen ground. They seek shelter in caves when startled, where the chill around their ancient bodies lingers long after they have gone.

catalogEntries.entry: Gelus may be small, but their heavy paws can leave deep prints in frozen ground. They seek shelter in caves when startled, where the chill around their ancient bodies lingers long after they have gone.

Gelus often cling to their Tamers during cold weather, despite being comfortable in freezing temperatures themselves. Their instinct to guard companions hints at the formidable cave bears they can become.

enitoys.name: Urstocene

enitoys.name: Sparstrange

enitoys.name: Ninaron

enitoys.name: Vivanish

catalogEntries.entry: Vivanish resemble enormous predators from a vanished age. They emerge almost without sound, and their spectral presence has inspired stories of ancient reptiles returning from extinction.

enitoys.name: Antinnian

enitoys.info: The glitches corrupting this Enitoy have grown so severe that its physical body has transformed into an ancient arcade cabinet. Its surrounding energy constantly flickers between distorted shapes, occasionally displaying fragments of games that were never programmed into its system. Despite its unstable nature, it possesses extraordinary processing power.
